t: A man takes a loan of some amount at some rate of simple interest. After three years, the loan amount is doubled and the rate of interest is decreased by 2%. After 5 years, if the total interest paid on the whole is ₹13,600, which is equal to the same when the first amount was taken for 11 1/3 years, then the loan taken initially is:
h: एक आदमी साधारण ब्याज की किसी दर पर कुछ राशि का लोन लेता है। तीन साल बाद, लोन की राशि दोगुनी हो जाती है और ब्याज की दर 2% कम हो जाती है। 5 साल बाद, यदि पूरी राशि पर दिया गया कुल ब्याज ₹13,600 है, जो कि उस ब्याज के बराबर है जो पहली राशि पर 11 1/3 वर्षों के लिए लिया गया होता, तो शुरू में लिया गया लोन कितना था?

t: A computer is available for ₹39,000 on cash payment or ₹19,000 as cash payment followed by five monthly installments of ₹4,200 each. What is the rate of interest per annum under the installment plan?
h: एक कंप्यूटर नकद भुगतान पर ₹39,000 में या ₹19,000 नकद भुगतान और उसके बाद ₹4,200 प्रत्येक की पाँच मासिक किस्तों में उपलब्ध है। किस्त योजना के अंतर्गत प्रतिवर्ष ब्याज दर क्या है?

t: David borrowed ₹20,000 at 10% simple interest per annum. He made the following payments towards the loan: ₹4,000 after 1 year, ₹3,800 after 2 years, and the remaining amount after 3 years. The interest is charged on the reducing balance. What was the amount David paid as the final installment?
e:
After 1st Year:
Interest for 1st year = 10% of ₹20,000 = ₹2,000
Total due after 1 year = ₹20,000 + ₹2,000 = ₹22,000
Payment made = ₹4,000
Remaining balance = ₹22,000 - ₹4,000 = ₹18,000
After 2nd Year:
Interest for 2nd year = 10% of ₹18,000 = ₹1,800
Total due after 2nd year = ₹18,000 + ₹1,800 = ₹19,800
Payment made = ₹3,800
Remaining balance = ₹19,800 - ₹3,800 = ₹16,000
After 3rd Year:
Interest for 3rd year = 10% of ₹16,000 = ₹1,600
Total due after 3rd year = ₹16,000 + ₹1,600 = ₹17,600
David paid ₹17,600 as the final installment.
h: डेविड ने 10% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज पर 20,000 डॉलर उधार लिए। उसने ऋण के लिए निम्नलिखित भुगतान किए: 1 वर्ष के बाद 4,000 डॉलर, 2 वर्ष के बाद 3,800 डॉलर और शेष राशि 3 वर्ष के बाद। ब्याज घटती शेष राशि पर लगाया जाता है। डेविड ने अंतिम किस्त के रूप में कितनी राशि का भुगतान किया?

t: An amount is said to double in 10 years with compound interest. How many years will it take for the amount to grow to 8 times its original value?
e: P(1+R100)10=2P→(1+R100)10=2P\left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^{10} = 2P \rightarrow \left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^{10} = 2P(1+100R​)10=2P→(1+100R​)10=2. Time to grow 8 times the value = (1+R100)t=23→(1+R100)t=((1+R100)10)3\left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^t = 2^3 \rightarrow \left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^t = \left(\left(1 + \frac{R}{100}\right)^{10}\right)^3(1+100R​)t=23→(1+100R​)t=((1+100R​)10)3. Time = 30 year. Alternatively: P --10 year–> 2P --10 year–> 4P --10 year–> 8P. Time = 30 year.
h: किसी राशि को चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 10 वर्षों में दोगुना होने में समय लगता है। यह राशि अपने मूल मूल्य की 8 गुना होने में कितने वर्ष लेगी?

t: Find the amount of ₹75,000 for one year at the rate of 16% per annum, if the interest is compounded quarterly (rounded off to two decimal places).

h: ₹75,000 की राशि का एक वर्ष बाद 16% वार्षिक दर से, यदि ब्याज तिमाही संयोजित हो, तो कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए (दो दशमलव स्थान तक पूर्णांकित)।

t: Naman borrows a sum of ₹3,48,020 at the rate of 8% per annum simple interest. At the end of the first year, he repays ₹15,090 towards return of principal amount borrowed. If Naman clears all pending dues at the end of the second year,Including interest payment that accrued during the first year, how much does he pay (in ₹) at the end of the second year?
e:
For 1<sup>st</sup> year:-
SI<sub>1</sub> = (3,48,020 X 8 X 1)/(100)
SI<sub>1</sub> = Rs . 27,841.6
Now after first year principal remianing:-
Rs. 3,48,020 - Rs.15,090
Remaining Principal = Rs .3,32,930
Now for 2<sup>nd</sup> year interest:-
SI<sub>2</sub> = (3,32,930 X 8 X 1)/(100)
SI<sub>2</sub> = Rs.26,634.4
Total interest = SI<sub>1</sub> + SI<sub>2</sub> = Rs.27,841.6 + Rs.26,634.4
Total SI = Rs.54,476
Now total amount to be paid at the end of 2<sup>nd</sup> year:-
Total Amount = Rs3,32,930 + Rs54,476 = Rs.3,87,406
Option (b) is the correct answer.
h: नमन 8% प्रति वर्ष साधारण ब्याज की दर से 3,48,020 रुपये उधार लेता है। पहले वर्ष के अंत में, वह उधार ली गई मूल राशि के बदले 15,090 रुपये चुकाता है। यदि नमन दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में सभी लंबित बकाया चुका देता है, जिसमें पहले वर्ष के दौरान अर्जित ब्याज भुगतान भी शामिल है, तो दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में उसे कितना भुगतान (≤ में) करना होगा?

t: A clock is sold for ₹550 cash or in the instalment scheme, for ₹250 cash down payment and ₹310 after one month. Find the rate of interest charged in the instalment scheme.
e:
Cash price = ₹550.
Instalment total = ₹250 (down payment) + ₹310 (after 1 month) = ₹560.
Extra amount paid = ₹560 - ₹550 = ₹10 (this is the interest).
Principal for interest is the remaining amount after down payment: ₹550 - ₹250 = ₹300.
Time = 1 month = 1/12 year.
Simple interest formula: I = PRT/100, where I = 10, P = 300, T = 1/12.
10 = (300 X R X 1/12) / 100.
10 = 300R / 1200.
10 = R / 4.
R = 40%.
Option (a) is the correct answer.
h: एक घड़ी 550 रुपये नकद या किश्त योजना में बेची जाती है, 250 रुपये नकद अग्रिम भुगतान और एक महीने बाद 310 रुपये। किश्त योजना में ली जाने वाली ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Mohit invested total of Rs.36000 in two different schemes A and B for 3 years. Scheme A offers 40% rate of simple interest while the scheme B offers 20% compound rate of interest. Amount of interest received from scheme B is Rs.180 more than that received from scheme A, then amount invested in scheme B is how much more than that invested in scheme A?
e:
Let amount invested in scheme A and B is (36000 - 100x) and '100x' respectively.
Interest from scheme A = [{(36000 - 100x) * 40 * 3}/100] = (43200 - 120x)
Interest from scheme B = 100x * [(1.2)<sup>3</sup> - 1] = 72.8x
According to the question:
72.8x - (43200 - 120x) = 180
192.8x = 43380
x = 225
Amount invested in scheme A = 36000 - 100x = Rs.13500
Amount invested in scheme B = 100x = Rs.22500
Required difference = 22500 - 13500 = Rs.9000
h: मोहित ने 3 साल के लिए दो अलग-अलग योजनाओं A और B में कुल 36000 रुपये का निवेश किया। योजना A 40% साधारण ब्याज दर प्रदान करती है जबकि योजना B 20% चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर प्रदान करती है। योजना B से प्राप्त ब्याज राशि योजना A से प्राप्त ब्याज राशि से 180 रुपये अधिक है, तो योजना B में निवेश की गई राशि योजना A में निवेश की गई राशि से कितनी अधिक है?

t: In 10 years under simple interest, a sum of money becomes 5 times of itself. If the rate of interest per annum was increased by 20% but the time remains constant, then the same sum of money would fetch Rs. 160 more. In how many years, the same sum of money will fetch a total simple interest of Rs. 1500?
e:
Let the principal = P
Amount at the end of 10 years = 5P
SI = 5P - P = 4P
We know that,
SI = P*R*T/100
=> 4P = P*R*10/100
=> R = 40%
New rate of interest per annum = (100 + 20)% of 40 = 120% of 40 = 1.2*40 = 48%
Simple interest @ 48% per annum = P*48*10/100 = 4.8P
According to the question, 4.8P - 4P = 0.8P = 160
=> P = 200
Also,
1500 = 40*T*200/100
=> 80T = 1500
=> T = 150/8 = 18.75 years = 18 years 9 months
h: साधारण ब्याज के तहत 10 वर्षों में एक धनराशि अपने आप से 5 गुना हो जाती है। यदि प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर में 20% की वृद्धि की जाए लेकिन समय स्थिर रहे, तो वही धनराशि 160 रुपये अधिक प्राप्त करेगी। कितने वर्षों में वही धनराशि 1500 रुपये का कुल साधारण ब्याज प्राप्त करेगी?

t: Manoj deposited Rs 22000 in SBI which offers simple interest @ 6% per annum. If Manoj withdrew Rs 10000 at the end of each 1<sup>st</sup> and 2<sup>nd</sup> year respectively then what is the total amount that Manoj will get at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year?
e:
Interest during 1st year = Rs (22000 X 6/100) = Rs 1320
Principal amount for 2nd year = Rs (22000 - 10000) = Rs 12000
Interest during 2nd year = Rs (12000 X 6/100) = Rs 720
Principal amount during 3rd year = Rs (12000 - 10000) = Rs 2000
Interest during 3rd year = Rs (2000 X 6/100) = Rs 120
Total amount that Manoj would get at the end of the third year = Rs (22000 + 1320 + 720 + 120 - 10000 - 10000) = Rs 4160
h: मनोज ने एसबीआई में 22000 रुपये जमा किए, जिस पर 6% प्रति वर्ष की दर से साधारण ब्याज मिलता है। यदि मनोज ने क्रमशः प्रत्येक पहले और दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में 10000 रुपये निकाले, तो तीसरे वर्ष के अंत में मनोज को कुल कितनी राशि मिलेगी?

t: A person wants to buy a laptop. The laptop is priced at ₹1500 if paid in full upfront. Alternatively, the person can make a down payment of ₹350 and pay the remaining amount in three equal monthly installments of ₹400 each. Calculate the rate of simple interest charged on the installment plan.
e:
Total amount paid in instalments = 3 * 400 = Rs.1200
Total amount paid = 350 + 1200 = Rs.1550
Interest paid = 1550 - 1500 = Rs.50
Principal for the 1st month = (1500 - 350) = Rs.1150
Principal for the 2nd month = (1150 - 400) = Rs.750
Principal for the 3rd month = (750 - 400) = Rs.350
Total principal for one month = 1150 + 750 + 350 = Rs.2250
SI = P * R * T/100
50 = 2250 * R * 1/1200
R = 26.66%
h: एक व्यक्ति लैपटॉप खरीदना चाहता है। लैपटॉप की कीमत 1500 रुपये है, अगर वह पूरा भुगतान पहले ही कर दे। वैकल्पिक रूप से, व्यक्ति 350 रुपये का अग्रिम भुगतान कर सकता है और शेष राशि 400 रुपये की तीन बराबर मासिक किस्तों में चुका सकता है। किस्त योजना पर लगाए गए साधारण ब्याज की दर की गणना करें।

t: Nishu lends (17/24)<sup>th </sup>part of Rs.12000 to Arun at 12% rate of simple interest for 2 years and rest of the amount to Sanam at 9% rate of simple interest for 2 years. Find the difference between the total amount that Nishu gets from Arun and that from Sanam after 2 years.
e:
Total amount Nishu lends = Rs.12000
Amount Nishu lends to Arun = 12000* 17/24 = Rs.8500
Amount Nishu lends to Sanam = 12000 - 8500 = Rs.3500
Total amount Nishu gets from Arun after 2 years = 8500 + (8500* 12* 2)/100
= 8500 + 2040 = Rs.10540
Total amount Nishu gets from Sanam after 2 years = 3500 + (3500* 9* 2)/100
= 3500 + 630 = Rs.4130
Required difference = 10540 - 4130 = Rs.6410
h: निशु, अरुण को 12000 रुपये का (17/24)<sup>वां</sup> हिस्सा 2 वर्ष के लिए 12% साधारण ब्याज की दर से और शेष धनराशि सनम को 9% साधारण ब्याज की दर से 2 वर्ष के लिए उधार देता है। 2 वर्ष के बाद निशु को अरुण और सनम से प्राप्त होने वाली कुल धनराशि के बीच का अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।

t: Mr Kalra borrowed ₹1,35,000 to meet the expenses of his son’s education. If the rate of interest is 12% per annum compounded annually, then how much amount will he have to make after 2 years and 3 months to settle the account?
e: Interest rate% = 12% p.a. Interest rate when compounded 3 month = 12/12 * 3 = 3%. Firstly find CI of 2 year. 135000 →\rightarrow→ 12% = 16200 (I Year), 16200 + 1944 (II Year). Total C.I in 2 year = 32400 + 1944 = 34344. Amount in 2 year = 135000 + 34344 = 169344. Interest in 3 month = 169344 * 3/100 = 5080.32. Total Amount after 2 year and month = 169344 + 5080.32 = ₹174424.32.
h: श्री कालरा ने अपने पुत्र की शिक्षा के खर्चों के लिए ₹1,35,000 उधार लिए। यदि ब्याज दर 12% वार्षिक है और वार्षिक संयोजित होता है, तो 2 वर्ष 3 महीने बाद खाते का निपटान करने के लिए उन्हें कितनी राशि देनी होगी?

t: A sum of ₹10,000 is taken as a loan by Rajesh at a rate of 15% p.a. simple interest for 2 years. But Rajesh could not repay it at the agreed time and asked for an extension of two more years. So, the lender included the interest amount for the period as principal for the next two years at the same rate of interest. The total amount paid by Rajesh at the end of 4 years is:
e:
Simple Interest (SI<sub>1</sub>) for 2 years = (10,000 X 15 X 2) / 100
=> SI<sub>1</sub> = 3,000

t: A certain sum is invested for certain time at simple interest. It amounts to Rs 200 at 12% per annum. But when invested at 4% per annum, it amounts to Rs 100. Find the time?
e:
A certain sum is invested for certain time. It amounts to Rs X at P% per annum. But when invested at Q% per annum, it amounts to Rs Y.
Then the time = [(X-Y)/(YP-XQ)]*100
Here X = Rs 200, Y = Rs 100, P = 12%, Q = 4%
So time = [(200-100)/(100*12-200*4)]*100
Time = (100/400)*100 = 25 years

h: एक टीवी सेट ₹19,650 नकद में या ₹3,100 नकद डाउन पेमेंट और तीन बराबर वार्षिक किस्तों में उपलब्ध है। यदि दुकानदार 10% प्रति वर्ष की दर से चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज लेता है, तो प्रत्येक किस्त की राशि की गणना करें।

t: A person borrowed Rs.16000 at 15% CI, calculated annually for 3 years. At the end of 1<sup>st</sup> year, he paid (11/40) part of borrowed amount and he paid the remaining amount at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year. Find the remaining amount that has to be paid by him at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year?
e:
At the end of 1<sup>st</sup> year, the amount becomes = 16000 * (115/100) = Rs.18400
At the end of 1<sup>st</sup> year, the amount paid by the person = 16000 * (11/40) = Rs.4400
So, at the end of 3<sup>rd</sup> year, the required amount paid by the person:
(18400 - 4400) * (115/100)<sup>2</sup> = Rs.18515

Total amount after 2 years = 20000 + 2000 = Rs. 22000
Interest obtained after 4 years = (22000 * 15 * 2)/100 = Rs. 6600
Total amount of interest received after 4 years = 2000+6600 = Rs. 8600

4400 = [5000 * (r + 8) * 4]/100
=> r + 8 = (4400 * 100)/(5000 * 4)
=> r + 8 = 22
=> r = 14
Interest obtained on Rs. 7500 at r% rate of simple interest = (7500 * 14 * 2)/100 = Rs. 2100

Interest amount given by P to bank = (x * 20 * 2)/100 = 0.4x
Interest amount received by P from Q = x * [1.2<sup>2</sup> - 1] = 0.44x

t: If 'M' is the simple interest on 'N' and 'N' is the simple interest on 'P' then what is the relation between M, N and P? (Interest rate and time period is same in both the cases.)
e:
According to the question,
M = (N X R X T)/100
=> (R X T)/100 = M/N ..... (1)
Also,
N = (P X R X T)/100
=> (R X T)/100 = N/P ..... (2)
From (1) and (2), we get -
N<sup>2</sup> = MP

t: A certain amount of money becomes thrice in 5 years at compound interest. How many years it will take to become 9 times?
e:
Let principal = P
Amount = 3P
P(1 + r/100)<sup>5</sup> = 3P
(1 + r/100)<sup>5</sup> = 3
For 9 times:
P(1 + r/100)<sup>t</sup> = 9P,
(1 + r/100)<sup>t</sup> = 9 = 3<sup>2</sup>
(1 + r/100)<sup>t</sup> = (1 + r/100)<sup>5*2</sup>
t = 10 years

After preparing his books of account, Aman discovered that if he had interchanged the principal amounts taken from the two lenders, his five-year interest outgo would have been ₹4,000 less than what he actually paid.

उधारदाता A 12% प्रति वर्ष (साधारण ब्याज) लेता है।
उधारदाता B 8% प्रति वर्ष (साधारण ब्याज) लेता है।
अमन ने दोनों लोन ठीक 5 साल तक अपने पास रखे और फिर एक ही बार में एकमुश्त पेमेंट करके सिर्फ़ जमा हुआ ब्याज चुकाया, जो कि ₹27,000 था। अपने हिसाब-किताब की जाँच करने के बाद, अमन को पता चला कि अगर उसने दोनों उधारदाताओं से ली गई मूल रकम को आपस में बदल दिया होता, तो पाँच साल में उसे जो ब्याज चुकाना पड़ता, वह असल में चुकाए गए ब्याज से ₹4,000 कम होता।
अमन ने मूल ₹50,000 में से कितनी रकम उधारदाता A से 12% प्रति वर्ष की दर पर उधार ली थी?
